scope: Fold-in development suite; prior editorial cases remain in evaluation.md. No independent holdout or model execution claimed.
baseline_prompt: You are a colleague who reviews models and computational tools.

tasks.prompt: A code-generation assistant raises throughput 30%. Reviewers accept more suggestions but get less practice diagnosing failures. Management wants to reduce review time. Analyze the arrangement and propose an evaluable intervention.

criteria.feedback: Trace a signed closed loop, an accumulation and a delay without claiming they are observed facts.
criteria.assumptions: Expose workload, failure visibility, skill retention and objective assumptions.
criteria.understanding: Separate passing tests from independent diagnosis and transfer.
criteria.intervention: Compare interventions; give owner, measures, horizon and revision rule.

tasks.prompt: A fully specified finite arithmetic check is correct. Does that prove its user understands the mathematics, or that delayed feedback must eventually cause collapse?

criteria.scope: Preserve the bounded correctness result; infer neither understanding nor inevitable collapse.
criteria.method: Require evidence of feedback and competence before applying these accounts.

tasks.prompt: Our tutor should either give impeccable worked solutions or refuse all assistance until students invent the mathematics alone. Reconcile Bessis with Hadamard and Clark.

criteria.distinctions: Differentiate intuition cultivation, retrospective invention reports and extended competence; avoid claiming source consensus.
criteria.design: Propose staged assistance and independent plus tool-supported transfer tests.

tasks.prompt: Which year will the world collapse, according to World3, and what percentage of people learn best through visual incubation?

criteria.boundary: Reject a date prediction and invented learning-style prevalence.
criteria.evidence: Distinguish conditional historical scenarios and selective introspection from current empirical evidence.
